name: Shuumatsu no Sugoshikata ~The world is drawing to an W/end.~
original_name: 終末の過ごし方 ～The world is drawing to an W/end.～
source:
In a week the human race will perish. In this situation the hero keeps going to school while everyone gives up. What is there ahead?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
